incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: Pavii.Ai opened, but the local Pavii Engine backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart Pavii.Ai.

incompleteInstallation.title: Pavii.Ai installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so Pavii Engine cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest Pavii.Ai. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined Pavii Engine.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest Pavii.Ai package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined Pavii.Ai components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: Pavii.Ai package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This Pavii.Ai package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: Pavii.Ai opened, but Pavii Engine stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling Pavii.Ai may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: Pavii.Ai opened, but Pavii Engine stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling Pavii.Ai may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: Pavii.Ai opened, but Pavii Engine could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart Pavii.Ai.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: Pavii.Ai detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, Pavii.Ai will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: Pavii.Ai is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another Pavii.Ai startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart Pavii.Ai.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: Pavii Engine is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: Pavii Engine couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: Pavii Engine didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: Pavii Engine failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry
